children: Large IPOs are drawing more global investors, boosting market depth and recycling capital back into India's economy, according to Abhinav Bharti, Head of India ECM, JPMorgan. Speaking from the sidelines of JPMorgan India Conference, Bharti said that he also sees more MNC listings and quality issuers entering the market. Why is India becoming a year-round fundraising destination? Watch the full interview.

title: India's IPO market set to beat last year's record as capital market depth grows: JPMorgan’s Abhinav
